newsitem.title: USA: Chrysler Corp Q4 net falls after charges.
newsitem.headline: Chrysler Corp Q4 net falls after charges.

text.p: NOTES - '96 Q4 includes total after-tax charges of $279 million or $0.39 per fully diluted share. All per-share and average share data adjusted for two-for-one split.

Charges cover $191 million for early retirment of $550 million in debt; $51 million for writedown of Pentastar Electronics investment; $31 million for lump sum retiree pension costs associated with new UAW contract; $6 million for early retirement program initiated in Q3 '96.
Chrysler '96 Q4 net before charges was $1.086 billion or $1.51 per fully diluted share vs $1.04 billion or $1.33 per fully diluted share.
(All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTES - 1996 full year includes total after-tax special charges of $347 million. 1995 full-year includes total after-tax special charges of $329 million.
Automotive cash at end of Q4 $6.95 billion vs $6.89 billion.
Chrysler Financial 1996 net $376 million vs $339 million.
Q4 '96 worldwide factory unit shipments 753,326 vs 741,770. 1996 full year 2,958,800 vs 2,673,539.
Q4 '96 retail unit (including fleet) sales for U.S. and Canada 626,879 vs 574,987. 1996 full year 2,690,340 vs 2,389,465.
Q4 '96 U.S., Canada light vehicle market share 16.1 percent vs 14.9 percent. 1996 full year 16.1 percent vs 14.7 percent.
